response.sql: SELECT SUM(state_total) as total_sum, AVG(invoice_count) as avg_invoices_per_state FROM (SELECT c.State, SUM(i.Total) as state_total, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) as invoice_count FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State) state_summary

assumptions.assumption: The 'between' range is inclusive on both boundaries (using >= and <=)
Standard SQL type coercion handles the comparison of DATETIME InvoiceDate to text string literals correctly without explicit casting
